status: registered before the paid retest of the same 36 frozen items after full-suite green; covers time-derivation adjudication, necessary-citation augmentation, dense second probe, recall limit 12->16 and the inference-marked knowledge fallback
concurrency_scope: Only the final Memoria framework; two isolated histories in parallel, questions serial within history.
baseline: Full visible conversation before question; drop oldest whole turns only if byte/window budget exceeded. Record every truncation.
memoria: Native Memoria with distinct bounded missing-demand probes, prior-gap reassessment, calendar-complete time answers, one targeted same-source clock derivation adjudication for a missing time requirement, verified necessary-citation augmentation instead of answer discard, dense-lane second supplement probe with fused degradation, recall limit 16, and one inference-marked knowledge fallback for explicitly inference-flavored questions; fallback answers are never cited, never support-verified and never written as memory.
judge: Independent binary LLM with frozen adapted permissive rubric; no arm label or evidence override. Gold used only after answering.
failure_policy: Planned IDs stay in denominator; unknown judge coverage and answer errors are separate. No filtered-accuracy promotion.
accounting: Every formation, consolidation, Reader, support, repair and grading call. Shared ingestion once per visible-history hash. Missing usage stays unknown; retained upper reservation is not an invoice.
resume: Not implemented. Keep checkpoints, isolated databases and append-only calls. New execution is a new charged run.
interpretation_limits: Repeated development sample; no unseen generalization or independent human labels.
One complete Memoria framework group; no four-arm experiment or pure causal attribution.
Same locomo-dialogue-and-blip-caption-v2 input as v15, with original question IDs, Judge, models and per-case caps unchanged.
Unanswerable reference labels may conflict with plausible original-text readings; report unchanged scores and AI-assisted source audit separately.
Official source IDs measure post-hoc visibility, not semantic necessity or sufficiency.
billing_policy: Two consecutive insufficient-balance responses open a global circuit; retain every planned ID as not_run. No automatic top-up or retry.
authorization: User approved P0-P3 performance work and the 36-question paid retest; full-benchmark reruns still require separate explicit authorization.

sampling.method: first two histories; four uniformly sampled questions per category per history; no answer/gold/failure filters

additional_changes: Second supplement probe runs on the dense-only ranking lane and degrades explicitly to fused lanes when dense recall is empty.
One bounded adjudication may bind a missing time requirement as basis=derived from a same-source utterance/clock pair; any contract failure keeps the missing judgment.
Reader answers citing a subset of verified necessary citations are published with the necessary provenance appended instead of being discarded; unseen citations still fail publication.

Knowledge fallback fires only for explicitly inference-flavored questions (would/could/might...) on a final missing/unsupported state, is marked basis=inference, and never bypasses adversarial refusals.
Kernel recall limit raised from 12 to 16 candidates within the same gate pool and evidence budgets.
budget_note: One complete 36-case paid retest of the same frozen items after full engineering suite, 38-scenario simulation and both local BGE checks pass on the final code fingerprint. The v18 run, all failures and unknown usage stay immutable. No selected-item retries, no new full benchmark.
